steps.journalDescription: I read a piece of Page's diary. It explains that she is the slave assigned to tutor the Director's kids, and had a hunch that there are hidden passages built into the Manse. Page thought there might be one such passage within the Manse's library.
I have found the hidden passage.

I read another piece of Page's diary. This piece describes a passageway that will allow me to travel from the meeting room on the north side of the first floor directly into the Director's office, bypassing any defenses that the guards may have deployed. However, I will still need the key to the office to access the passageway.
I have opened the hidden passage.
